title: pix_opencv_contours_boundingrect
description: `pix_opencv_contours_boundingrect` detects multiple contours and calculates an upright bounding rectangle for each detected contour, making it useful for motion tracking when objects are well isolated. It can draw bounding rectangles or contours, filter detections by minimum and maximum area, and reports rectangle data such as X origin, Y origin, width, and height.
